programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda. You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there's the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there's plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou's tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an "Emporium of the World"!

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the "La'aomen" harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: "Mountain Orchid Rice".

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan's explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of "opening the gate", the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou's rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its "three carvings and one engraving" technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. programme.title: An Encounter with China's Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father" - Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group - who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the "La'aomen" harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: "Mountain Orchid Rice".

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan's explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of "opening the gate", the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou's rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: An Encounter with China's Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father" - Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group - who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there's the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there's plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou's tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an "Emporium of the World"!

programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there's the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there's plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou's tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an "Emporium of the World"!

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the "La'aomen" harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: "Mountain Orchid Rice".

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan's explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of "opening the gate", the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou's rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its "three carvings and one engraving" technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. programme.title: An Encounter with China's Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father" - Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group - who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the "Roof of the World" in China's southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group's lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master's skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang's story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: Major League Pickleball Asia
programme.desc: Major League Pickleball (MLP) arrives in Asia this November, featuring six professional co-ed teams competing over five weeks for the inaugural MLP Asia title. The competition features Women's Doubles, Men's Doubles and Mixed Doubles matches, with teams battling through pool rounds and semifinals before the champions are crowned on Super Saturday. If the match ends in a 2–2 tie, the exciting DreamBreaker™ singles game will determine the winner. Get ready for fast-paced action, intense rallies and thrilling team competition!

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: National Anthem
programme.desc: The broadcast of Malaysia’s national anthem, Negaraku, marks the beginning of the daytime broadcast schedule.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation of human-interest stories from around the world. This episode features a Women-run hotel in Sri Lanka that empowers women through the tourism industry. It also highlights Traditional wooden toy-making in Channapatna, India, where local artisans strive to preserve their craft amid modernisation and competition from imported products. Efforts to save the northern white rhino at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya continue through in vitro fertilisation (IVF) technology to prevent the subspecies from becoming extinct. Meanwhile, Benin’s textile industry is expanding its local manufacturing capabilities, shifting from raw cotton exports to textile production to create jobs and boost the country’s economy. The episode also explores the importance of international engagement and dialogue in helping countries such as Malaysia compete in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Global Perspective
programme.desc: This episode of Global Perspective discusses the evolution of Malaysia’s foreign policy since Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took office in November 2022, focusing on strengthening ties with Islamic countries in areas including the Palestinian issue, economic cooperation, education and moderation. The programme also highlights Malaysia’s strategic relations with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Central Asia, as well as the potential for international media collaboration to strengthen diplomacy and deliver accurate information to global audiences.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us explores diverse cultural traditions, artistic expressions and heritage from around the world, including ice carving in Japan, a unique peanut butter art installation in Rotterdam, Arabian horse traditions in Palestine and camel racing in Australia. This episode also highlights the traditional fishing practices of the Imragan community in Mauritania, France’s return of historical Syrian artefacts, and Malaysia’s strategic role in strengthening international relations and amplifying the voices of the Global South.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa ASEAN is an 11-episode travelogue featuring fusion cuisine from ASEAN countries while showcasing local cultures and traditions. Hosted by Chef Fikri and Chef Naim, the programme brings together professional and renowned chefs to explore the region’s diverse culinary heritage.\n\nIn this episode, both chefs travel to Cambodia to discover its local cuisine and cultural traditions.

programme.title: ASEAN - Jejak Halal ASEAN
programme.desc: Jejak Halal ASEAN is a travelogue exploring the diverse cultures and lifestyles of Muslim communities across ASEAN countries. In this episode, the programme travels to Songkhla, Thailand, to discover the local Muslim community and its way of life.

programme.title: ASEAN -Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: This episode of ASEAN Women Entrepreneurship highlights the determination of women entrepreneurs from Cambodia and Brunei in developing their businesses and contributing to economic growth. It also explores the challenges they face, the importance of support systems, and business strategies in empowering women to succeed in entrepreneurship.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa ASEAN is an 11-episode travelogue featuring fusion cuisine from ASEAN countries while showcasing local cultures and traditions. Hosted by Chef Fikri and Chef Naim, the programme pairs them with professional and renowned chefs to explore the region’s diverse culinary heritage. In this episode, the two chefs explore Indonesian cuisine in Malaysia, discovering its distinctive flavours and culinary influences.

programme.title: ASEAN - Jejak Halal ASEAN
programme.desc: Jejak Halal ASEAN is a travelogue exploring the diverse cultures and lifestyles of Muslim communities across ASEAN countries. In this episode, the programme travels to Hatyai, Thailand, to discover the local Muslim community and its way of life.

programme.title: Muslim World - Syahadah : Uzbekistan
programme.desc: Travelogue exploring the history and development of Islam in Uzbekistan, tracing its rich Islamic heritage, historic sites and enduring influence on the country’s culture and society.

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 同学八宝箱
programme.desc: 嗨，小朋友们！欢迎来到《同学八宝箱》！这是一个藏着无数秘密和惊喜的超级宝箱！只要轻敲三下，里面就会跳出好听的童话故事、神奇的科学冷知识，还有超级爆笑的校园趣事！无论是在上学路上、放学途中，还是睡前的陪伴时刻，快和我们一起打开八宝箱，收获满满的快乐和智慧吧！

programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 孤芳自赏
programme.desc: 在快节奏与商业大片的喧喧嚷嚷之外，总有一些电影选择安静地立于角落，散发着独一无二的光芒。这里是《孤芳自赏》，一处专属于高冷影迷与独立电影的声音（视觉）放映厅。\n\n我们带你穿透繁复的光影，解读那些被低估的冷门佳作、艺术大师的独行之作，以及镜头深处最隐秘的人性角落。不追热门，不作媚俗之语。今夜，让我们在独立的光影世界里，孤芳自赏。

programme.title: The Straight Path Convention 2026
programme.desc:
Who influences us, and how do we influence others? The Straight Path Convention 2026 brings together Islamic scholars and speakers to explore the power of influence in our everyday lives.
Streaming live on 14 & 15 November 2026 (Saturday & Sunday), from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM MYT (GMT+8) exclusively on Tonton, the convention explores how family, friendships, media, and role models shape our choices. Discover guidance from the Qur’an and Sunnah on strengthening faith, inspiring positive change, and leaving a meaningful legacy.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

programme.title: Fengmen Village Horror
programme.desc: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amy's Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 3 Demons
programme.desc: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

programme.title: The Getaway
programme.desc: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

programme.title: Projek R
programme.desc: Cikgu Baharom berjumpa kumpulan Rahman kerana mahu mereka melakar mural lagi. Mural bunga raya yang dilakar oleh Mohan mendapat pujian guru besar. programme.title: Tetangga

Haji Samad sering menjadi orang tengah untuk mendamaikan mereka. Namun, apabila Kassim Komando tiba-tiba menghilang, Mon mula merasakan kesunyian dan tertanya-tanya tentang kehilangan jiran yang sering menjadi musuhnya itu.
